description: Return the highest-rated (or, with `order: "worst"`, the lowest-rated) real establishments in a UK city / local authority, optionally filtered by business type (e.g. "restaurant", "takeaway", "cafe", "pub"). Each result includes name, address, postcode, business type, star rating and inspection date. Use this for "where can I safely eat in <city>?" or "which places failed hygiene checks in <city>?".

business_type.description: Optional business-type filter, matched case-insensitively against FSA business types, e.g. "restaurant", "takeaway", "pub", "cafe", "retailer".

order.description: "best" (default) returns the highest-rated; "worst" returns the lowest-rated.

name: find_top_rated_restaurants
title: Find the best- or worst-rated places to eat in a city
